objective: Encourage consideration of environmental cost and responsible consumption.
businessContext: The message ran during a high-consumption retail period and aligned with an established repair and environmental program.
strategy: Use an anti-consumption headline to invite reflection and reinforce a long-held operating position.
outcomes: The advertisement became a durable expression of Patagonia's environmental positioning.
whatWorked: The claim aligned with observable company practices rather than appearing as a temporary slogan.
whatFailed: The apparent paradox is easy for other brands to imitate superficially.
transferConditions: The organization has long-running operational proof consistent with the provocative message.
nonTransferConditions: Do not borrow anti-consumption language when revenue practices and product durability contradict it.

sources.title: Don't Buy This Jacket, Black Friday and the New York Times
